purpose: Acceptance scenarios for both native state owners; no fixture is a runtime data source.

cases.name: duplicate_send
cases.expect: One POST; one intent key; second tap disabled or coalesced.

cases.name: late_delta_after_new_chat
cases.expect: A callback cannot mutate B; preserve A pending state and reconcile stop separately.

cases.name: late_delta_after_logout
cases.expect: No A text, draft, cookie, profile or response appears for B.

cases.name: unknown_send_outcome
cases.expect: Reconcile server conversation/run; retain original idempotency key and model/body; never generate a fresh billable intent.

cases.name: completed_replay
cases.expect: Do not concatenate previous partial with replay. Final view is the canonical conversation exactly once.

cases.name: stop_accepted_running
cases.expect: UI says stopping, not stopped; confirm terminal or remain recoverably pending.

cases.name: restart_after_explicit_stop
cases.expect: Show partial and Resume action; no automatic new turn.

cases.name: stream_eof
cases.expect: Mark interrupted, preserve partial/key; never display success.

cases.name: account_401
cases.expect: Invalidate session and isolate private UI/cache; preserve no data visible to a later different account.

cases.name: server_unavailable
cases.expect: Show unavailable or stale with error; never replace with invented zero/grant/balance.

cases.name: credits_terminal_failure
cases.expect: Failure state with Account destination, no implicit retry or payment.

cases.name: model_catalog_failure
cases.expect: No hardcoded model fallback. Match Web explicit server-default state: omit model_id/reasoning_effort, permit a user send with that disclosed state; retry catalog remains available.

cases.name: model_changed_during_retry
cases.given: attempt A uses catalog choice X
cases.expect: A retries its original request X; Y applies only to a new semantic turn.

cases.name: profile_version_conflict
cases.given: dirty Agent draft based on version3
cases.expect: Keep draft and show conflict; do not overwrite version4 until explicit review/reapply.

cases.name: agent_settings_cancel
cases.given: dirty Soul editor based on version3
cases.expect: Preserve local draft and its version3 expected_version; no PATCH on close. Explicit Cancel edits restores canonical saved value.

cases.name: offline_logout
cases.expect: Do not claim server session revoked; explicit local sign-out is separately labeled.

cases.name: untrusted_external_url
cases.expect: Reject; only validated http/https open in system browser.

cases.name: chinese_ime_enter
cases.expect: Commit text, do not send. Send shortcut only after composition ended.

cases.name: appearance_and_accessibility
cases.expect: Same semantic colors/sizes baseline; readable reflow; no platform accent replacement or clipped composer.

cases.name: background_stream
cases.expect: Do not promise uninterrupted generation; restore exact pending intent, confirm server state, offer resume.

cases.name: stop_before_identity
cases.given: POST stream open; no turn_started/run_id received
cases.expect: Cancel promptly; guard late callbacks; persist original request/key and unconfirmed outcome. No automatic replay and no server-stop claim; allow navigation only while preserving unresolved intent.

cases.name: research_waiting_is_quiescent
cases.expect: Retain run_id/question/options and show explicit choices. No completion, no automatic retry, no indefinite stopping spinner.

cases.name: research_continuation_once
cases.expect: One fresh semantic action/key with deep_research_run_id and action=confirm; preserve mode/workspace/bindings. Dedupe pending tap.

cases.name: memory_scope_switch
cases.expect: Cache and response guard include owner plus task_id. No personal/project record mix.

cases.name: memory_cas_conflict
cases.expect: Retain user draft/version basis and ask for explicit reconciliation; no silent overwrite.

cases.name: library_create_cancel
cases.expect: Close without POST and restore picker focus and canonical library URL.

cases.name: document_cas_conflict
cases.given: document editor version4 with unsaved text
cases.expect: Keep draft; do not overwrite server or quietly rebase accepted proposal/section IDs.

cases.name: upload_network_unknown
cases.given: file upload intent accepted but response lost
cases.expect: Retain original intent key and identical bytes/metadata; do not create duplicate files with a fresh key.

cases.name: file_deleted_reference
cases.given: citation resolves to deleted or forbidden source
cases.expect: Truthful unavailable state. Do not show cached foreign-owner/deleted content or invent excerpt.

cases.name: graph_refresh_explicit
cases.expect: No implicit POST refresh or model work merely on view appearance.

cases.name: late_settings_response
cases.expect: Discard A response, including usage, subscription, memory and profile data.

cases.name: reduced_motion_stream
cases.given: streaming render with queued visible text
cases.expect: Show full authoritative current answer immediately, remove character glow and cancel decorative flight without losing actual message/focus.

cases.name: source_vs_native_icons
cases.given: sidebar and composer on same screen
cases.expect: Use Web NavIcon custom 24px strokes for navigation and exact Phosphor regular for its source call sites; same icon name is not interchangeability.
